title: What Did New Horizons Discover Inside Pluto's Frozen Heart?
alt_title: Why Does Pluto's Frozen Heart Have Zero Impact Craters?
long_title: Why Pluto's Frozen Heart Has Zero Craters
spoken: Across Pluto's horizon, in distant orbit around our sun, what would you see on the bright western half of its icy heart? A frozen nitrogen glacier about 1,000 kilometers wide, larger than Texas and Oklahoma combined, with zero craters. On 13th and 14th July 2015, NASA's New Horizons spacecraft flew within 12,500 kilometers of Pluto, 39 times farther from the Sun than Earth, at minus 232 degrees Celsius, and solved that mystery.
